blow_die.description:
A blow's roll spans this much, centred on the striker's skill: its margin is the skill
plus a roll from minus half this to plus half.

blow_dodge_per_agility.description: The dodge a unit puts up per point of agility.

blow_graze_share.description: A graze's share of the blow's damage.

blow_high_ground.description: Added to the margin of a striker on higher ground than its target.

blow_hit_band.description: How wide the hit band is above the target's defence; a margin past it is a critical.

blow_morale_shift.description:
Added to a formation's units' margins by its morale band: steady, shaken, wavering,
routing.

blow_parry_share.description: The parry a unit holding a weapon or shield puts up: this share of its melee skill.

blow_rear_arc_degrees.description:
A blow from within this many degrees of straight behind the target is from its rear,
denying its dodge as well as its parry.

blow_surrounded.description: Added to the margin for each foe beyond the first striking the target this tick.

bodies_brush.description:
A loose friend of its own squad overlapping a unit in its frame by less than this
(cells) only brushes it: it keeps its place.

bodies_ground_drag.description:
Bodies on the ground (Decision 121): a marching front stepping over one slows to
1 / (1 + its mass over the walker's times bodies_ground_drag); one at least
bodies_ground_block times the walker's mass blocks it.

bodies_passes.description: How many times a tick overlapping bodies are pushed apart.

bodies_resist.description: How many times over a unit in its formation's frame weighs, against being pushed.

bodies_steer_look.description:
How far ahead (cells) a unit looks for a body in its way, and how far clear (cells) of
it it aims to pass.

combat_contest_die.description:
The contest die: a roll from 0 to this, added to initiative, decides who takes a
contested slot (0: stats alone).

condition_cap.description: The most a unit's condition (Decision 125) may lift what it multiplies.

condition_drain_below.description:
Below this condition a unit loses HP, standing or downed, the faster the further below:
condition_drain a second at condition 0, scaling with the distance below the threshold -
so one left in a bad enough state dies of it rather than lie there, the faster the worse.

damage_floor_skill.description:
The skill at which a blow's damage floor has risen to its full; each point of skill
past it adds damage_spill to the blow's margin (crits) instead.

damage_weak.description: A blow's worth against a target weak to, resistant to or immune to its damage type.

discipline_expected_max.description: The discipline a formation is expected to have at most; more buys no more.

discipline_leash_shares.description:
The share of the expected most at or above which a pursuer takes the second, third and
fourth leash steps; under the last, the fifth. A leader's "pursues" tactic steps it one
out, "cautious" one in.

discipline_leash_steps.description:
How far (cells) a pursuer may go from where it set out, step by step: the steadier, the
shorter its leash; the last is no leash (inf), while it can see its enemy.

discipline_march_pace_at.description:
The discipline at which it re-forms at the march pace; the pace scales with it, within
the slowest and fastest shares of the march pace.

discipline_meets_threats.description:
At or above this a formation re-forms as a whole to meet a flank; below it, unit by
unit. A unit under it may break ranks to chase, the more likely the further under.

discipline_per_leadership.description: What each point of a formation's best leader's leadership adds to its discipline.

fall_damage_per_cell.description: A unit spent on a climb face falls: this hurt a cell dropped, × its area^fall_mass_power.

ground_cliff_quarters.description: A rise of more than this many quarter-cells is a cliff: climbed, a movement mode.

ground_slope_cost.description: The pace each quarter-cell risen costs; downhill is no faster.

ground_swim_pace.description:
Movement modes (spec 30): deep water is swum and a cliff climbed at a base pace times
the pair rule (Decision 64: swimmer/climber against flows/climb difficulty, default
ground_climb_demand); past ground_mode_load_share of its first load band, neither.

ground_wading.description:
The pace in water a quarter to a half of a unit's height deep (wading), and from a half
to its height (slow wading); deeper, it swims.

group_join.description: Cells to form up or split off together; the reach and hold (seconds) of taking the downed.

item_untrained_skill.description: Skill shifted wielding a weapon untrained or mastered in its tags.

item_weak_skill.description: Skill lost per point of strength short of a weapon's requirement.

load_easy.description:
Encumbrance by stage - none (to load_easy of its limit), mild (to its limit), steep (to
load_most times its limit, a hauler's level adding load_hauler each) and immobile
beyond: its pace, how fast it tires and its dodge, times these.

load_march_tiring.description: Stamina a second marching under each stage of load (marching light costs nothing).

load_per_strength.description: Load a unit carries without trouble, per point of strength: its carry limit.

morale_loss.description:
Morale lost for each unit of its own that falls, and per point of a fallen leader's
leadership.

morale_per_leadership.description: The ceiling's rise per point of its best leader's leadership (Decision 81).

morale_pressure.description: Morale lost each second by how many sides it fights on (0, 1, 2, 3, 4 or more).

morale_recovery.description: Morale regained each second out of contact, before its leadership is added.

morale_side_impact.description: Morale lost when struck on a side or on the rear.

morale_steady_at.description: The bands' floors: steady at or above the first, shaken at or above the second.

morale_support_cells.description: Cells within which a friendly squad supports a side.

path_look.description: Groups look path_look cells ahead every path_relook, going round if path_detour_gain quicker.

pursuit_ragged_shock.description:
The rout a ragged retreat costs: up to this much shock, for a formation with no
discipline at all.

pursuit_tempted_within.description: How near (cells) a unit must stand to a retreating enemy to be tempted to chase.

reach_contact.description:
How far apart (cells) two units' bodies may be and still touch: a unit stepping back
still reaches the one it is leaving.

reach_engage.description: How far apart (cells, between their cells) two units may be for their squads to engage.

reach_front_arc_degrees.description:
A point lies in a unit's front when its direction is within this many degrees of its
bearing; a blow from anywhere else is a flank blow.

reach_pursuit_lag.description:
How far (cells) a pursuing formation's foremost unit may lag behind its place before the
frame waits for it.

rout_crush.description: Crush damage per cell of a router's footprint, to friends it shoves past.

rout_fan_degrees.description: How far a wholly disorderly flight fans out: degrees off its route's line, and cells out.

rout_panic.description: Morale lost by a friend a router crushes, and by a friend that sees a formation rout.

rout_rally_reach.description:
How near (cells, a router's centre to a friend's body) a router must come to a led
formation to rally to it.

rout_rally_seconds.description:
Seconds with no enemy within rout_enemy_near cells before a led rout re-forms (and a
withdrawal is safe).

rout_reformed_morale.description: The morale a re-formed rout starts at.

rout_steady_rally_seconds.description: Seconds a caught router waits with its friend steady before it joins it.

rout_strike_reach.description: How near (cells, centre to centre) a pursuer must be to strike a router.

run_build_seconds.description:
Seconds a unit takes to build up from a march to its full run, and the seconds a
pursuer of average wits takes to react before it starts to (Decision 126): a retreat's
head start.

scrum_anticipate.description: How far off (cells) a disciplined squad re-forms to meet a threat closing in.

scrum_crowding.description: The share of its pace a unit makes walking within a fight: the crush.

scrum_leash.description: Cells a unit in a fight may go from its place to reach a foe.

scrum_stall_seconds.description: Seconds a fight may stand with nobody able to strike before it is released.

scrum_trade_seconds.description: Seconds a unit walking back to its place may come no nearer before it trades places.

sight_budget.description:
Sight by obscurance (spec 30): a sight line sums each cell's obscurance by the distance
run through it, seeing no further past sight_budget; woods and fog paint theirs.

stamina_climb.description:
Stamina a second spent climbing and swimming (spec 30): at half the mode's pace a step
takes twice as long, so costs twice as much (ModeStamina).

stamina_per_constitution.description:
Stamina per point of constitution; spent a second running and per blow struck (Decision
125). Each cost restarts a breather: once stamina_delay seconds have passed with none,
it is regained at stamina_recovery a second - both for a unit of average constitution,
the delay shorter and the rate faster the hardier it is, the rate times its condition.

stamina_tired.description:
Below these shares of its stamina a unit is tired, then spent: its pace times
stamina_pace and its skill shifted by stamina_skill, by stage (fresh, tired, spent). A
pursuer (or chaser) whose stamina falls below stamina_give_up gives up the chase.

walk_slack_drilled.description:
Cells a unit may lag its place before its formation waits (at discipline 100, 0); past
walk_lost it has fallen behind; past walk_face_travel it faces where it walks.

wounds_body_weight.description: The weight of a body borne by a friend, per cell of its footprint (Decision 126).

wounds_condition.description:
Each wound - a time downed (Decision 126) - takes this off a unit's condition; a unit
"hardened N" shrugs off its first N.

wounds_danger_reach.description:
Playing dead (Decision 127): a downed unit due to come to with a standing foe within
wounds_danger_reach cells lies still instead by a seeded chance - wounds_play_dead at
average wits, more with wits, plus wounds_cunning a level of "cunning" (its own or its
leader's) - and looks again every wounds_play_dead_check seconds. A foe about to take
it is fooled when the body's wits beat its own, each with wounds_trait_wits a level of
"cunning" or "thorough", in a roll of wounds_believe_die.

wounds_messenger_shock.description: Morale lost by each standing formation of a side one of its own is sent home to.

wounds_reach.description:
Cells within which a standing unit finishes or takes a downed foe; a friend standing
within wounds_guard_reach of the downed guards it, and a unit with a standing foe that
near is still fighting, not finishing.

wounds_regeneration_halt.description: Seconds a blow of a type that stops a unit's regeneration stops it for.

wounds_surrender.description:
The chance a routing unit struck surrenders, times its want of courage (1 - courage
/ 100).

wounds_wake_seconds.description:
Seconds a downed unit of average constitution lies before it comes to at 1 HP, times a
seeded share between wounds_wake_spread's two ends; the hardier, the sooner.
